notes.title: Big Update Has Arrived! v1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

It’s been 3 months since Suna has been released. Today, I’m going to publish a big update I made for you. With this update, Suna has many improvements, such as new animals that improve the atmosphere of the game, new story content, and a linked puzzle, NPC’s are now talkable, new animations and a customized mouse cursor. 


Another news is that I’ve been working on a new project. I can say that it will be a very different game in style. It will be a fun game with interactive focus, riddles and platform stuff. If everything goes well, I hope to finish the game late summer. Of course Suna will be getting updates regularly, there are still lots of stuff I have planned but right now I am focused on preparing my new game.


Note: The new story contains a bit of a hard puzzle. The only clue I can give is that, in order to begin this new story you have to find something in the town. You can speak with townsfolk for getting more clues.


- Key Features -

* A short story content and a linked puzzle have been added. When you solve it you will witness the beginning story of the new game I’m working on and you will win a new achievement. 
* Many new animals have been added to various areas, including deers, rabbits, butterflies, frogs, crabs, scorpions, birds, snails. The game world is more alive now!
* You will be able to talk to NPC’s in town and in other areas.
* If you get closer to Warrok, you may come across an unpleasant surprise, and the pirate on the beach can now chase you and kill you when he sees you.
* Some new NPC animations have been added.
* The girl in the lake is now swimming slowly, but be careful that she may not like to be bothered.
* A new mouse cursor has been added.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This is the first patch for Suna.

-Changes-

* Spanish language is added now!  (Thanks to Santiago Lequio for translation.)

* Improved LOD for trees.

* Some minor bug fixes.
